title: Legality and Legitimacy
grammar: Recap: *nem csak … hanem* and *miközben* for a contrast
goal: I can tell legality from legitimacy (*legalitás*, *legitimitás*).
I can say that something is formally legal but lacks legitimacy (*híján van a legitimitásnak*).
I can contrast two ideas (*nem csak …, hanem …*).
